Static for the Chumby One.

**Install:** unzip `static-chumby-*.zip` onto the root of a FAT32 USB stick, plug it into a chumby that's already on Wi-Fi, and restart the chumby. Hold the top button for the menu, then tap **Install on this chumby** to keep it. Full instructions are in the [README](https://github.com/madewith-bestpractice/static-chumby#install).

`latest.json` is the manifest the on-device updater reads.
